description:
Activate Urza's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it, looking at a random card in target player's hand and creating a delayed triggered ability.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Urza's Bauble from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Thran Vigil triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer.
Cast Urza's Bauble from the top of your library by paying 0 life through Gwenom.
Repeat.
